component_score_method.search_rule: Only fresh asset-specific Google Trends related_queries with timeframe now 1-d; no global NIFTY or 7-day fallback.
component_score_method.news_rule: Only publisher-timestamped asset-specific headlines no older than 24 hours; age is recomputed from published_at; source_date is newest eligible headline date in IST; cross-index duplicate stories excluded.
component_score_method.participant_oi_scope: CLIENT CE/PE is shared market-wide; CLIENT Futures enters provisional Finals only after fresh 14-session all-index promotion gate; neither is index-specific.

index_score_method.crowd_basis: directional_bull_bear_ratio; (BULLISH%-BEARISH%)/(BULLISH%+BEARISH%) maps to -10..+10; NEUTRAL information interest is displayed separately
index_score_method.client_excluded_reason: NSE participant OI has not demonstrated a validated out-of-sample predictive edge; it remains diagnostic only.
